Alicia M.: Quick flag 1:30 - v3.0-int4 A/B showed rerank score drift on conversational followups (slice: multi-turn-helpdesk).
Erin L.: Can you quantify the drift?
Alicia M.: Median rerank delta -0.12 (models prefer previous ordering), anchor precision@3 down 4.6 points. Not huge globally but spikes on queries with >6 turns.
Ben S.: Hm. Our canary gating rule is: if any primary metric delta >3.0% on a critical slice for 10m -> soft-fallback. Secondary rule: if multi-metric degradation (quality + latency) persists for 30m -> hard rollback.
Chloe P.: Reminder: soft-fallback flips 20% traffic to fp16-stable for 15m while notif-ing owners; hard rollback pins stable tag and cancels rollout. We also have 'tiered-circuit' which escalates if slice-specific uplift >x.
ci-bot: nightly-compare finished: diff report https://ci.internal/diffs/6473001111 (artifacts attached)
Alicia M.: Observed that int4 with per-channel calibration reduces rerank drift by ~60%, but inside quant-kernel we see slight tokenization misalignments on the repeated system prompts.
Erin L.: Can we run a targeted 8k-sample A/B on just >6-turn conversations with two variants: V1=int4 per-channel, V2=int4 + warm-kv + adjusted tokenizer? Want stable stats before we decide.
Ben S.: Yes. Decision: block global promotion. Run 8k stratified A/B (seeded) and feed to the metrics gate. Auto-fallback thresholds: precision@3 drop >3.0 OR rerank-delta < -0.08 -> trigger soft-fallback; if both precision drop and latency p95 > +25ms for 20m -> hard rollback.
Chloe P.: Adding hysteresis: require anomaly persist across at least 2 consecutive 10m windows to avoid flapping. Also enable sample logging for any query that flips ordering between variants.
telemetry: Scheduling stratified run (8,000 queries) scoped to multi-turn-helpdesk. Interim aggregates every 10m. Run id: tr-6473001111
deploy-bot: queued A/B experiment on shadow infra; will post when ready.
Alicia M.: Local sanity script I used:
```
# pseudo-eval
slice = "multi-turn-helpdesk"
variants = ["per-ch-int4","per-ch-int4-warmkv-tokenfix"]
results = run_ab(variants, n=8000, stratify_by=turn_count>=6)
pass = (results.precision_at_3.delta > -0.03) and (results.rerank_median_delta > -0.08) and (results.latency.p95_delta < 25)
```
Erin L.: Good. If the pass condition fails we'll execute soft-fallback and kick off a kernel-compatibility triage. Ben, Chloe: please prepare the fallback policy object and the watchbook.
Ben S.: On it. I'll JSON the policy and test the flip in staging.
Chloe P.: We'll wait for telemetry final. If pass -> soft-promote 2% for 1h then bump. If fail -> immediate soft-fallback and postmortem ticket.
